title: S2-A bridge ref + Bugatti text

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the PLACE; the scene must be exactly this view of the bridge. Parked on the road or viewpoint in the foreground, front three-quarter view, is this car: A low, wide Bugatti two-door coupe, viewed from the front-left corner. The body is pale metallic ice blue with mirror-polished silver side panels and a dark roof. A large silver-edged C-shaped curve surrounds the side window and deep intake behind the door. The short nose has a tall black horseshoe grille with a small red Bugatti badge, broad black mesh lower intakes, and a glossy black splitter. Narrow headlights contain four rectangular LED elements each. Raised front fenders flank a sculpted hood with long recessed channels. The steep, dark windshield has one diagonal wiper. Large wheels have angular silver-and-black split spokes and low-profile tires. Small ice-blue mirrors project from the doors. No people.

must_haves: The view is the Golden Gate Bridge from the attached photo.

The car matches the description (low wide two-door coupe, pale metallic ice blue with polished silver side panels, large C-shaped curve around the side window, horseshoe grille with red badge, four-element LED headlights, split-spoke wheels).
